items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: It was Cecil McBee that told me about students in Boston. Because he teaches at the New England Conservatory...

ctx.x: Do you find most of your colleagues do some educational type gigs?

A lot of them do, yeah. A lot of them do. In fact that’s how I get inspired to do it. It was Cecil McBee that told me about students in Boston. Because he teaches at the New England Conservatory and Berklee had called me up there to do a concert. And there was a clinic right before the concert. And it was an unbelievable clinic. I got these great questions, which I had never gotten before in a clinic. So then they called me to do a residency, but I was like, I can’t go there three days a week, no. So I told them…
